description: Read public books and immutable ETF reports, then inspect fixed-three-month industry flow with honest published-data gaps.
steps: Open the library, verify PocketStocks-Staging indicator and sample research covers.
Search for AI, filter by sector and tag, then reset filters; enter an unmatched search and verify the no-results state before resetting.
Open a sample book detail, start reading, use Next and Previous and thumbnail rail collapse/restore.
Reload the page-specific reader URL and return to the library.

Open 主動式ETF. If no reports are published verify the honest empty list; otherwise open a published report and switch 分析總結, 產業異動, 基金共識, 營運對照, 數據與來源. Verify only one panel visible, open a heatmap cell and fund source table, return to the original Tab, then reload and use Back. Open optional 持股配置 and 法人對照 if available, verify filters survive switching. Open an unpublished report URL and recover to list.
Open 主動式ETF then 歷史追蹤. Verify single ETF and optional 產業 filters, fixed 最近3個月 actual dates and 資料截至. No date, period, stock, AUM, net-subscription or reader-version controls are present.

Choose two ETFs in succession; the selected name and data must agree after completion. Choose an available industry. Switch 熱力圖, 趨勢, 數據 and compare date, fund, industry and億元 values. Data不足 remains missing, never zero or a made-up line. Use actual published coverage; do not assume complete backfill while imports are still running.

Focus a heatmap cell by keyboard, use arrow keys and Enter; verify date, industry and amount or precise missing reason. Close detail and verify focus returns. Reload and use Back/Forward; valid ETF, industry and active view restore. Return to research and verify published report remains unchanged.

Open #/active-etf/history?dataset=synthetic. Verify the persistent fictional-data notice, QA fund names and fixed three-month window. Existing published QA fixture should show positive and negative colors, daily trend bars and matching exact monetary values; return to research data and verify no QA names leak into normal history.
expected: Public reading and immutable report Tabs remain usable. Industry history has one ETF/optional industry query, fixed rolling three-calendar-month dates and one active heatmap/trend/data view. Currency comes only from published source monetary evidence; exact zero differs from unknown, missing dates stay gaps and partial samples are labeled. Keyboard detail restores focus, valid filters restore after reload, quick switches never show a previous fund result. QA scope remains explicitly isolated; existing reports and author data are unchanged.

name: Reader identity and private collections
description: Reader sign-in retains return intent and app-local collections.
steps: While signed out use a sample book favorite action and verify the reader sign-in boundary; cancel and verify the book remains available.
Complete reader sign-in through the platform popup using the authorized test identity, then favorite a sample book.
Open My Library, reload and verify the saved favorite; remove it and reload to verify removal.
Open Reviews and verify the fresh-account empty state; preserve existing-review-only behavior without inventing first-review creation.
Sign out and verify private collections are no longer visible.
expected: The reader returns to the book after sign-in, staging favorites persist and can be removed, fresh private reviews are empty, and logout removes private data from the UI.

name: Comments and private reader forms
description: Visitors and readers contribute through existing comments and private forms.
steps: Open a sample WebReader comment dialog, attempt blank submission, then submit an anonymous comment with name Staging QA and body Staging anonymous comment.
Reload and verify the comment; open Discussion and choose the same book.
Sign in as a test reader, post an owned comment Staging owned comment, locate it in My Reviews and delete only that disposable comment with confirmation.
Submit a private suggestion Staging suggestion and a research-interest request Staging research request through their existing forms; verify validation and confirmation/detail states.
expected: Blank comments are blocked, anonymous comments persist, owned comments are removable by their author, and reader forms save privately in staging.

description: Authors persist private reports and normalized daily tasks, validate complete snapshots, and explicitly publish reviewed versions with recoverable outcomes.
steps: Open Admin and sign in using the securely configured staging master secret; never expose the secret in reports or screenshots.
Create disposable book Staging Publishing QA, edit its metadata and upload two actual test images through the UI; edit page descriptions, reorder pages and replace/remove a disposable page.
Save and reload, open the private preview, verify ordered images and authored descriptions; publish and verify the book in the public library.
Unpublish and verify it disappears from public discovery while retaining its admin draft; open Reader Feedback and inspect private forms.
Sign out and verify admin and private preview require authorization.

In the author ETF報告 workspace load the 10/13 research example. If a saved example already exists, open its saved entry rather than creating the same ID again. Validate, save draft, reload and reopen it; verify all 39 observations and official/date warnings in private preview. Do not assume the saved draft is published.

Confirm content and gaps reviewed, explicitly publish this staging-only example. Visit 主動式ETF and verify five-block detail. Open optional holdings and institutional views, switch funds/sectors/stocks and verify unknown small weights, source dates and shares versus ETF lots.

Back in author ETF workspace edit only the draft excerpt with marker Staging unpublished revision, validate and save without publication. Reopen public detail and verify that marker is absent and the last published version persists. Leave the sample public report intact.
Open the Author ETF task area after secure authorized sign-in; use 資料匯入, 驗證與缺口, 預覽, 發布紀錄. Verify task selection and unsaved edits survive or prompt before leaving.

Use a verified real source payload or clearly named disposable QA scope; create one date task, save bounded chunks and reopen it. Attempt malformed values/duplicate rows or an incomplete chunk set and confirm validation blocks publication. Restore the valid draft.

Inspect source/date/classification/precision warnings, private preview and fixed payload hash. Confirm review, then edit draft and check review becomes invalid. Without a report, explicitly publish only data in the staging QA scope; reload public query and verify persisted version. Private drafts/raw source files stay inaccessible to signed-out readers.

When a valid reviewed report is deliberately selected, preview data and full five-Tab report; explicitly publish together and verify both version pointers switch or both remain old. Do not overwrite the existing 10/13 research report for a QA scenario.

If the UI reports conflict or unknown outcome, use the same request status flow before another submission; reopen saved task and verify exact current publication. If a disposable scope has two published versions and restore is available, confirm a restore creates a new version while prior full reports remain unchanged.

Use the monthly task list to reopen a saved task, page the private preview and source details; inspect publication plan before confirming. Create a separate disposable unsent QA task and cancel only that task with confirmation; confirm no public state changes.

In the large complete-report mode, use a clearly labeled staging QA schemaVersion2 report above180KiB with valid fixed lineage. Save its bounded body pages, reload and reconstruct its private preview, validate and review. If format publication is not yet enabled, verify the explicit disabled reason rather than claiming a successful publish. After the coordinated compatibility cutover, explicitly publish this disposable report and reopen it through the public five-Tab reader; page hashes, complete body and immutable version must agree.

Open the existing saved real daily task without editing or publishing. Load all private preview pages and inspect industry allocation: unknown/rounded/bounded totals show no exact subtotal, genuine exact zero remains0%, individual source weights unchanged. In complete snapshot mode open a saved body URL, switch Tabs during initial loading and verify bodyId remains in URL; refresh only after load and verify same body identity.
expected: Staging-only draft and images persist, preview and publication follow saved page order, unpublished content is private, author feedback is restricted and logout revokes workspace access. Daily data tasks persist across reload, incomplete or unreviewed revisions cannot publish, and data-only or paired publication has one verified outcome. CAS conflicts and unknown receipts remain recoverable; restoring creates a new version, drafts and raw sources remain private, and existing full reports are immutable.

description: Invalid access and destructive actions keep the staging data boundaries intact.
steps: While signed out open Admin and a nonexistent private preview; verify no draft data is displayed.
Attempt one invalid master secret and verify a visible error without access.
Sign in as the authorized staging author; create disposable draft Staging Delete QA, attempt incomplete publication and verify validation.
Cancel deletion and verify the draft remains; confirm deletion of only Staging Delete QA, reload and verify absence.
Sign out, open an invalid public book/page URL and verify unavailable state with a route back to library.

In the authorized ETF workspace attempt malformed JSON and verify validation prevents saving/publishing; restore using the research example. If a save or publication outcome is uncertain, use 查詢結果 and verify the status is reconciled before any resubmission. While signed out #/admin/active-etf requires author unlock and a guessed draft detail remains unavailable.
expected: Invalid credentials and private access are denied, incomplete publication is blocked, cancelled deletion preserves data, confirmed disposable deletion persists and invalid routes have a visible recovery path.

Verify a visible load error and 重試 action; use 重試 and ensure the screen retains the query and does not invent values.
expected: A readable error and retry action are visible; the same selection remains and no unrelated data or fake flow is displayed.
